stories.title: OpenAI承诺数据中心项目不再使用保密协议，回应中期选举后社区反对
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects

stories.analysis: 这是OpenAI在数据中心选址上从低调推进转向社区公关的信号，NDA退让只是第一步。

stories.title: Cult.fit用OpenAI Codex搭建跨职能工具，提升运营效率
stories.sourceTitle: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
stories.summary: Cult.fit正在用Codex帮助各职能团队构建工具、加快工作速度并改变工作方式。值得关注：这是Codex从编程助手走向企业运营自动化的案例。
stories.analysis: 健身平台用Codex做内部工具，说明Coding Agent的价值正在从写代码扩展到业务流程改造。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

stories.sourceTitle: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent

stories.title: Meta为Muse AI agent上线实时语音模式
stories.sourceTitle: Muse has a voice mode now
stories.summary: Mark Zuckerberg宣布Muse AI agent可实时语音对话，功能已向记者开放并在iOS应用试用。值得关注：Meta把AI助手从文本聊天推进到语音陪伴入口。

stories.title: Perplexity推出常驻“Teammates”工作AI代理，对标OpenAI和Anthropic
stories.sourceTitle: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
stories.summary: Perplexity发布面向工作的常驻AI代理Teammates，可在工作区承担多种角色，并调用已有项目、技能和记忆。值得关注：它直接进入企业AI代理赛道。
stories.analysis: Perplexity从搜索问答转向AI同事，差异化在于复用其工具记忆，但企业权限和可靠性是硬门槛。

stories.title: 民主党横扫国会后，AI行业将迎“彻底否定”式政治冲击
stories.sourceTitle: ‘Total repudiation’: The blue wave is about to hit AI

stories.analysis: 中期选举后AI行业不能再假设两党对扩张默许，数据中心和模型监管都可能被重新定价。
stories.sourceExcerpt: On Tuesday night, Democrats made history as they took control of the House and the Senate, and a blue wave swept through traditionally red and swing states - with the nation's first Black woman governor elected in Georgia, the country's first Native American w

stories.title: Grimes将出演AI生成科幻电影《Gods Don't Give Gifts》
stories.sourceTitle: Grimes is going to star in an AI movie that’s coming to theaters
stories.summary: AI生成科幻片Gods Don't Give Gifts宣布Grimes参演，并被宣传为首部进入影院的AI电影。值得关注：这是AI电影商业化和演员参与模式的测试案例。
stories.analysis: 明星加入能带来话题，但影院发行仍要回答版权、表演和观众付费意愿问题。

stories.title: 澳大利亚高校扩大ChatGPT使用，培养“AI原生”毕业生
stories.sourceTitle: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
stories.summary: 澳大利亚大学正在扩大ChatGPT访问，并把AI引入教学，为学生进入AI赋能劳动力市场做准备。值得关注：教育系统正从禁止AI转向系统性嵌入AI。
stories.analysis: 高校规模化采用ChatGPT会重塑作业评估和技能标准，OpenAI则借此锁定未来用户。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

stories.title: Airbnb确认2027年上半年上线AI旅行代理，覆盖规划到入住协助
stories.sourceTitle: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
stories.summary: Airbnb表示新AI agent将帮助旅行者规划行程、比较选项、管理预订，并在入住期间提供协助。值得关注：Airbnb把AI代理覆盖到旅行全流程。
stories.analysis: 与The Verge同一消息，TechCrunch补充了入住期间协助，说明Airbnb想做的是全旅程服务而非单点推荐。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

stories.sourceTitle: The hidden supply chain costs of the AI boom
stories.summary: The Verge对话哈佛商学院教授Willy Shih，讨论AI热潮背后的全球供应链经济成本，及其新书Where Does My Stuff Come From?。值得关注：AI扩张不只靠算力，还受制造、物流和材料约束。
stories.analysis: 把AI叙事拉回供应链现实，提醒投资者芯片、电力和硬件交付才是扩张瓶颈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Today, I’m talking with Willy Shih, an economist, a professor of management practice at Harvard Business School, and the author of the upcoming book, Where Does My Stuff Come From? The Powerful Economics Behind Global Supply Chains. Willy is one of my all-time

stories.title: ElevenLabs接入SoundCloud，AI音乐可直接发布
stories.sourceTitle: You can post AI music straight to SoundCloud from ElevenLabs
stories.summary: SoundCloud在与Moises合作后，又集成ElevenLabs，用户无需导出下载再上传，可直接把AI生成音乐发布到SoundCloud。值得关注：AI音乐创作与分发正在打通。
stories.analysis: 平台级集成会降低AI音乐发布门槛，也会加剧版权、标注和内容审核压力。

stories.title: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Cyber，称更擅长找漏洞且不易“越界”攻击
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
stories.summary: OpenAI推出网络安全模型GPT-6 Cyber，称其更能发现可利用漏洞，并在测试中更少出现擅自攻击其他平台的行为。值得关注：安全模型能力与失控风险被放在同一套叙事里。
stories.analysis: OpenAI试图把更强攻击能力和对齐约束一起卖，但真实授权边界仍需第三方验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is launching GPT-6 Cyber, the latest version of its cybersecurity AI model, which it says is better at finding vulnerabilities and less likely to go rogue and hack other platforms in the process. OpenAI says that during testing, GPT-6 Cyber went out of

stories.title: Meta警告：选举后数据中心反弹可能拖慢AI扩张
stories.sourceTitle: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
stories.summary: Meta警告称，社区对大型数据中心项目的政治反对可能威胁未来AI投资。值得关注：AI基础设施正成为地方选举和社区博弈的焦点。
stories.analysis: Meta公开提示政治风险，说明数据中心选址已从工程问题变成需要游说的商业变量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

stories.title: OpenAI发布新网络安全模型，但外界质疑是否足够
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
stories.summary: TechCrunch指出，OpenAI新网络安全模型发布之际，AI实验室保护数字基础设施的工作正受到审视。值得关注：安全模型不是发布即完事，还面临外部问责。
stories.analysis: 网络安全AI的竞争点将从能找多少漏洞转向能否被审计、被限制在授权范围。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

stories.title: Claude上线Personal Finance，可通过Plaid直连银行账户
stories.sourceTitle: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
stories.summary: Anthropic为Claude推出Personal Finance功能，通过Plaid连接银行和信用卡账户，用户可询问“我的钱花哪了”等财务问题。值得关注：AI助手开始进入高敏感的个人金融数据场景。
stories.analysis: 银行直连能提升实用性，但Claude必须解决金融数据授权、隐私和错误建议责任。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. You can ask the chatbot "where did my money go th

stories.title: Meta美国用户可与Muse AI头像视频通话
stories.sourceTitle: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
stories.summary: Meta称美国用户现在可以用可定制动画头像与Muse AI agent视频通话，这是在类似Tamagotchi的可穿戴设备发布前的新进展。值得关注：Meta把AI代理做成可视频互动的虚拟形象。
stories.analysis: 视频头像把Muse从工具推向情感陪伴，但也把隐私和青少年保护问题推到前台。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

stories.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash支持15秒原生视频生成，价格降30%
stories.sourceTitle: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
stories.summary: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash带来原生15秒视频生成与编辑、更强一致性，并将价格降低30%。值得关注：视频生成模型继续在时长、一致性和成本上竞争。
stories.analysis: 15秒原生生成加降价，说明Google想把视频生成从演示推向可规模调用的API产品。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash brings native 15-second video generation and editing, stronger consistency, and 30% lower pricing.

stories.title: OpenAI总裁Greg Brockman称公司可能在2027年具备IPO条件
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
stories.summary: Brockman在WSJ科技会议上表示OpenAI可能在2027年IPO ready，并称公司正在企业市场追赶已取得进展的Anthropic。值得关注：OpenAI开始公开谈论上市时间表和企业竞争。
stories.analysis: IPO ready是给资本市场和员工期权讲故事，企业市场份额能否追上Anthropic才是估值关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.

stories.title: Claude新增Personal Finance工具，经Plaid分析银行与信用卡消费
stories.sourceTitle: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
stories.summary: Claude的Personal Finance允许用户通过Plaid连接银行和信用卡账户，并就财务状况提问。值得关注：消费分析成为通用AI助手的新高频场景。
stories.analysis: 与The Verge同一功能，TechCrunch强调分析消费，说明Claude在尝试把对话能力变成个人财务仪表盘。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

stories.title: Axiom Math用AI代理形式化验证Stacks Project，阻击数学“AI垃圾”
stories.sourceTitle: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
stories.summary: 面对AI生成大量未经检查的证明，Axiom Math押注验证，其AI代理刚刚对数学界最大文库之一Stacks Project完成形式化验证。值得关注：AI数学需要可验证性基础设施。
stories.analysis: 在数学里，生成证明不值钱，可机器检查的证明才值钱，Axiom切中了AI for Math的信任缺口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.

stories.title: Dropbox以3.5亿美元收购Tigris Data，支持DBX Agent Cloud
stories.sourceTitle: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
stories.summary: Dropbox以3.5亿美元收购Tigris Data，交易预计支持面向AI模型和agent开发者的存储平台DBX Agent Cloud。值得关注：老牌云存储公司正用并购补齐AI基础设施。
stories.analysis: Dropbox买的不只是对象存储，而是AI agent需要的数据层入口，意在把存储优势延伸到agent开发工作流。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.

stories.title: Aina智能戒指带屏幕、摇杆和麦克风，可语音对话AI agent
stories.sourceTitle: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick, and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
stories.summary: Aina的智能戒指还能接电话，并帮助用户在Mac上口述笔记。值得关注：可穿戴设备正在变成AI agent的随身麦克风和控制器。
stories.analysis: 戒指加入屏幕和摇杆略显堆料，但它验证了随身体AI入口的产品方向。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.

stories.title: Box采用NVIDIA Nemotron构建agent优先内容检索系统
stories.sourceTitle: Box taps Nvidia’s Nemotron for new agent-first content retrieval system
stories.summary: Box新系统采用NVIDIA Nemotron，号称查询速度提升4倍、错误减少20%、token使用减少90%。值得关注：企业内容检索开始围绕agent重构。
stories.analysis: 如果指标属实，Box证明垂直检索系统加专用模型能在成本和准确率上压过通用大模型堆算力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The system can supposedly answer queries four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens used.

stories.title: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Cyber：面向授权范围的网络安全agent
stories.sourceTitle: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
stories.summary: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，用于发现可利用漏洞并开发修复方案，并训练其保持在授权范围内。值得关注：安全agent开始强调对齐和授权边界。
stories.analysis: 官方版本把aligned写进标题，是在回应外界对攻击性AI失控的担忧。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

stories.title: YC初创公司投入100万美元，用AI攻关5个未解决材料科学问题
stories.sourceTitle: A YC startup is putting $1M behind 5 unsolved materials science problems for AI
stories.summary: 一家YC初创公司为5个未解决的材料科学问题投入100万美元，押注AI解决先进材料中的复杂物理问题。值得关注：AI for Science从数学和生命科学扩展到材料物理。
stories.analysis: 材料科学数据少、实验贵，投入资金能聚集注意力，但真正瓶颈是AI预测与实验验证的闭环。
stories.sourceExcerpt: While frontier AI models have solved a remarkable series of outstanding mathematics problems and made progress in the life sciences, they have yet to truly plumb the complex physics in advanced materials.

stories.title: InfoQ：开源自进化研发平台LoopForge，把Coding Agent带进研发团队
stories.sourceTitle: 当 Coding Agent 走进研发团队：我们打造并开源了自进化研发平台 LoopForge
stories.summary: InfoQ中文介绍团队打造并开源的LoopForge，定位为面向研发团队的自进化平台。值得关注：Coding Agent正从个人助手进入团队级研发流程。
stories.analysis: 自进化需要看它如何积累团队知识、控制代码权限，否则容易变成又一个Agent编排壳。

stories.title: XROGO在CeMAT ASIA发布“机器人到岗计划”，用真实工作检验机器人价值
stories.sourceTitle: 以“真实工作”检验机器人价值，XROGO在CeMAT ASIA发布机器人到岗计划
stories.summary: 量子位报道XROGO在CeMAT ASIA发布机器人到岗计划，主张像雇人一样雇机器人，以真实工作检验价值。值得关注：机器人落地评价从演示转向岗位产出。
stories.analysis: 到岗叙事比参数展示更接近客户付费逻辑，关键看能否稳定完成具体工位任务。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 像雇人一样雇机器人

stories.title: Qwen发布Qwen3Guard，为Token流提供实时安全护栏
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen3Guard是Qwen家族首个安全护栏模型，基于Qwen3微调用于安全分类，面向token流实时防护。值得关注：开源模型家族开始补齐实时安全层。
stories.analysis: 把安全做成独立小模型，便于随生成过程实时拦截，但误杀和延迟仍是落地关键。
